Introduction

Nabin, a trainee under Macaroni Media, was officially introduced as the newest member of L5ST on March 10, 2025. Since his reveal, he has appeared in group content, social media posts, and public events, although his official musical debut has yet to be confirmed. At present, publicly available information about him remains limited.
